buildCommand: node -e "const value = process.env.VITE_API_URL; if (!value) throw new Error('Missing VITE_API_URL'); const url = new URL(value); if (!['http:', 'https:'].includes(url.protocol)) throw new Error('Invalid VITE_API_URL protocol'); if (url.pathname !== '/' && url.pathname !== '') throw new Error('VITE_API_URL must be the backend origin only');" && cd frontend && corepack pnpm build
